component.name: Ars Arcanum
component.summary: Sovereign speculative fiction writing and worldbuilding operating system

description.p: Ars Arcanum (Scriptorium) is a 100% offline, privacy-first writing environment and worldbuilding studio tailored for novelists, screenwriters, and speculative fiction creators.

ul.li: Multi-Tier Cosmos & World Bibles: Characters, Factions, Magic Systems, Calendars, Dynastic Lineages, and Conlangs.
Universal Story Paradigms: 3-Act Structure, 8-Sequence Method, Save the Cat, Hero's Journey, Kishōtenketsu, Fichtean Curve, and Freytag's Pyramid.
Interactive Visual Story Canvas: Drag-and-drop scene corkboard with live pacing harmony score recalculation.
Dual-Track Timeline Synchronizer: Aligns narrative reading order with in-world chronological epochs and detects temporal paradoxes.
Multi-Volume Series Omnibus Compiler: Compiles multi-book series into unified omnibus editions with merged Dramatis Personae.
Speculative Fiction Craft Engines: Invariant craft and world lore linters across astrophysics, climate, genealogy, conlang, and magic.
Publication Toolchain: Compiles to Print PDF (Typst), EPUB3, and Word DOCX.
Fail-Safe Data Protection: Atomic writes, multi-tier Git version milestones, and optional GPG AES-256 encrypted backups.
